title: placeTrackerWork
responsibility: Ranks computers for new work by headroom, role and fit, and recommends the best one that fits.

inputs.name: placeTrackerWork.rows
inputs.description: Status and latest sample of each candidate computer.

inputs.name: placeTrackerWork.request
inputs.description: Kind of work, RAM it needs in GB and computers to leave out. Defaults to general work with none left out.

outputs.name: trackerWorkRamGB
outputs.description: RAM in GB that each kind of work is assumed to need.

outputs.name: placeTrackerWork
outputs.description: Candidates ranked with fitting ones first, their reasons, and the recommended computer or null.
